title: Layer B manifest
description: Maps Terraform resource/data-source addresses (as emitted by lib/parse/parse-dot-graph.mjs) to friendly entities for the compiled diagram. Enforced at runtime by lib/manifest/validate-manifest.mjs (hand-rolled, no ajv dependency) — this file is the human-readable reference, kept in sync by hand.

repoId.description: Identifies which source repo this manifest belongs to (e.g. "network", "infra"). Used by Layer C to know which manifest applies to which extracted graph.

rules.description: Evaluated in order; the first rule whose `match` matches a node wins. A node matching no rule is left unmapped (surfaced in the compiler's coverage report, not silently dropped).

type.description: Resource/data-source type to match (e.g. "aws_vpc"), or an array of types.

isData.description: When set, only matches data sources (true) or managed resources (false).

modulePathPrefix.description: Node's modulePath must start with this sequence (e.g. ["eks"] matches module.eks.* and module.eks.module.nodegroup.*).

nameRegex.description: JS RegExp source tested against the resource's local name (not its full address).

kind.description: Namespaced entity kind for the compiled diagram, e.g. "aws.vpc", "aws.eks.cluster". See the infra-diagram IR (not yet written) for the registered kind catalog.

idFrom.description: How to derive the entity's stable id: the resource's local name, its full Terraform address, or a literal string (requires `id`).

id.description: Required when idFrom is "literal"; ignored otherwise.

boundary.description: Optional containment boundary id this entity belongs to (e.g. "vpc"), resolved by Layer C against other matched entities.
